stateId.description: Unique identifier for the lifecycle state

description.description: Detailed description of the lifecycle state

allowedTransitions.description: List of transition IDs that can originate from this state

entryActions.description: Actions to perform when entering this state

exitActions.description: Actions to perform when exiting this state

isTerminal.description: Whether this is a terminal state (no outgoing transitions)

isInitial.description: Whether this is an initial state for new resources
